Evidence: Kerala recorded its highest ever daily Covid count of 46,387 new cases on January 20, 2022, with a positivity rate of 40.21%. In response to the surge, the state government announced a complete lockdown on the next two Sundays (January 23 and 30), allowing only essential services to function. Malls and theatres will be closed, and classes will be conducted online. District administrations can impose additional restrictions based on local case numbers (Source 1).
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly states that Kerala recorded its highest daily Covid count and imposed a lockdown on Sundays. Specifically, it mentions the number of new cases and the government's decision to enforce a complete lockdown on Sundays due to rising Covid cases, thus corroborating the claim.
